name: PayCore
tagline: Card & UPI payment gateway for 1,200 merchants
summary: PayCore processes card and UPI payments for online merchants: hosted checkout, acquirer integrations, a double-entry ledger, T+1 settlement, merchant webhooks and fraud scoring. One shared database pool, fragile webhooks and acquirer timeouts keep causing outages.

tour.headline: One shared database connection pool has caused three checkout outages; separating it costs 16 hours.

modules.name: gateway
modules.description: Card and UPI acquirer integrations (HDFC, ICICI, NPCI)

modules.name: checkout
modules.description: Hosted checkout API and payment sessions

modules.name: auth
modules.description: Merchant API keys and dashboard login

modules.name: db
modules.description: Shared database access layer and connection pool

satd: retry loop until acquirer SDK supports idempotency keys
pass timeout through to the NPCI client
batch jobs should not borrow from the request pool
persist the delivery attempt before sending
uses server local time, should be IST
TTL should depend on the payment step

incidents.title: Checkout API returning HTTP 500 during sale traffic
incidents.desc: From 20:05 IST checkout failed for about 38% of requests with HTTP 500. Logs show 'QueuePool limit of size 20 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out'. The outage lasted 34 minutes during a merchant flash sale.
whys: Checkout requests failed with HTTP 500
API workers timed out waiting for a database connection
The shared connection pool was exhausted
Settlement batch jobs held connections open for minutes
Batch jobs and the API share one connection pool with no isolation
incidents.fix: Raised the pool size from 20 to 40 and restarted the settlement worker.
incidents.lesson: A bigger pool hid the problem; batch traffic still competes with checkout traffic.

incidents.title: Merchant CSV export breaks when a business name contains a comma
incidents.desc: Settlement CSVs downloaded by merchants shift columns for names like 'Rao, Sons & Co' because fields are not quoted.
whys: Exported CSV columns were misaligned
Business names containing commas were not quoted
CSV is built by string concatenation instead of a CSV writer
incidents.fix: Switched the export to Python's csv.writer.
incidents.lesson: Use the standard library for file formats.

incidents.title: Merchants received the same payment.captured webhook twice
incidents.desc: Several merchants credited orders twice because payment.captured webhooks arrived two or three times. The retry worker resends when a merchant endpoint responds slowly.
whys: Merchants processed duplicate payment.captured events
The retry worker re-sent events that were already delivered
Delivery status is saved only after the HTTP call returns
No idempotency key or delivery log for outbound webhooks
incidents.fix: Increased the retry delay to 30 seconds.
incidents.lesson: Slower retries reduced duplicates but did not remove them.

incidents.title: Card authorisations failing with acquirer timeout
incidents.desc: Calls to the HDFC acquirer exceeded the 8 second client timeout and 12% of card authorisations failed between 11:00 and 11:40.
whys: Card authorisations failed
Requests to the acquirer timed out
The client timeout is hard-coded to 8 seconds with no retry budget
Gateway client has no circuit breaker or fallback acquirer
incidents.fix: Added one automatic retry on timeout.
incidents.lesson: Retrying against a slow acquirer adds load; we need a circuit breaker.

incidents.title: Daily settlement file short by Rs 4.2 lakh
incidents.desc: The settlement file for 18 merchants did not match ledger totals. Refunds processed after the cut-off were counted in two settlement days.
whys: Settlement totals did not match the ledger
Late refunds were included in two settlement days
The day boundary uses the container's UTC clock
Settlement cut-off rules have no automated reconciliation tests
incidents.fix: Adjusted the next day's payouts manually and re-ran reconciliation.
incidents.lesson: Manual adjustments fix money, not the cause.

incidents.title: Rotated merchant API keys kept working for hours
incidents.desc: After merchants rotated their API keys, the old keys continued to authenticate requests for up to six hours.
whys: Rotated API keys still authenticated requests
Key validation results are cached for six hours
The key cache is not invalidated when keys are rotated or revoked
incidents.fix: Reduced the cache TTL to 30 minutes.
incidents.lesson: A shorter TTL narrows the window but does not close it.

incidents.title: Fraud model declining legitimate high-value jewellery orders
incidents.desc: The risk engine declined 6% of orders above Rs 50,000 for a jewellery merchant; the manual review queue overflowed by evening.
whys: Legitimate high-value orders were declined
One risk threshold is applied to every merchant category
Risk thresholds are hard-coded instead of configured per merchant category
incidents.fix: Whitelisted the merchant temporarily.
incidents.lesson: Whitelists do not scale to other categories.

incidents.title: Ledger entry missing for partial captures
incidents.desc: Partial captures on split shipments created a capture record but no ledger posting, so merchant balances were understated.
whys: Merchant balances were understated
Partial captures did not create ledger postings
The posting rules only handle full captures
Partial-capture accounting was never specified
incidents.fix: Added a posting rule for partial captures and backfilled 312 entries.
incidents.lesson: Write the accounting rule down before coding it.

incidents.title: Payment status lookups time out around 01:30 every night
incidents.desc: Merchants report GET /v1/payments/{id} hanging for 30 seconds each night while reconciliation runs. The database shows many connections 'idle in transaction'.
whys: Payment status lookups timed out at night
API workers could not get a database connection
Long reconciliation transactions left connections idle in transaction
Batch jobs and the API share one connection pool with no isolation
incidents.fix: Added a statement timeout to reconciliation queries.
incidents.lesson: Second pool-starvation incident; same shared pool.

incidents.title: UPI collect payments stuck in PENDING
incidents.desc: NPCI responses slowed down and gateway threads waited indefinitely; 3,200 UPI payments stayed PENDING until manual reconciliation.
whys: UPI payments stayed in PENDING
Gateway threads blocked waiting for NPCI responses
The UPI code path does not apply any timeout
Gateway client has no circuit breaker or fallback acquirer
incidents.fix: Restarted gateway pods and reconciled pending payments with a script.
incidents.lesson: A timeout belongs in every outbound call.

incidents.title: Checkout shows the rupee symbol for USD merchants
incidents.desc: International merchants pricing in US dollars saw the rupee symbol on the hosted checkout page.
whys: Wrong currency symbol on checkout
The currency symbol comes from the platform default
Merchant currency is not passed to the checkout template
incidents.fix: Passed merchant currency into the template.
incidents.lesson: Templates should not read platform defaults.

incidents.title: Duplicate order confirmations sent to slow merchant endpoints
incidents.desc: Merchants whose servers took more than 10 seconds to reply got repeated capture callbacks for one payment and shipped two orders.
whys: Merchants received repeated callbacks for one capture
The notifier treated slow replies as failures and retried
No idempotency key or delivery log for outbound webhooks
incidents.fix: Raised the callback HTTP timeout to 20 seconds.
incidents.lesson: Duplicates are back whenever a merchant is slower than our timeout.

incidents.title: Refunds near midnight counted in two reconciliation runs
incidents.desc: Refunds created between 23:30 and 00:30 appear in both the T and T+1 reconciliation, forcing manual payout adjustments every week.
whys: Midnight refunds appeared in two reconciliation runs
The day boundary uses the container's UTC clock
Settlement cut-off rules have no automated reconciliation tests
incidents.fix: Excluded the overlapping window by a manual SQL filter.
incidents.lesson: Same cut-off bug as the settlement shortfall.

incidents.title: Monthly GST report takes 40 minutes to generate
incidents.desc: The GST summary report times out in the merchant dashboard; the query scans the entire transactions table.
whys: GST report generation was very slow
The report query scans the full transactions table
There is no index on transactions (merchant_id, created_at)
incidents.fix: Added a composite index on (merchant_id, created_at).
incidents.lesson: Check query plans for every new report.

incidents.title: Checkout session expires while customers wait for bank OTP
incidents.desc: Customers who spent more than five minutes on the bank OTP page came back to an expired checkout session and were charged without an order.
whys: Customers were charged but had no order
The checkout session expired during the OTP step
Session TTL is fixed at 5 minutes regardless of payment step
incidents.fix: Refunded 41 affected payments manually.
incidents.lesson: Session lifetime must follow the payment state.

incidents.title: Card authorisations timing out against the acquirer again
incidents.desc: Repeat of the acquirer timeout: 9% of card payments failed for 25 minutes. The automatic retry added after the previous incident doubled load on the already slow acquirer.
whys: Card authorisations failed
Requests to the acquirer timed out
Automatic retries doubled traffic to the slow acquirer
Gateway client has no circuit breaker or fallback acquirer
incidents.fix: Disabled the automatic retry; the acquirer recovered.
incidents.lesson: Our previous fix made this outage worse.

incidents.title: Revoked secret key used to issue refunds
incidents.desc: A merchant's leaked secret key was revoked at 10:12 but was used for seven refund calls until 13:40 because the auth service trusted a cached validation result.
whys: Refunds were issued with a revoked key
The auth service trusted a cached validation result
The key cache is not invalidated when keys are rotated or revoked
incidents.fix: Flushed the cache manually and reversed the refunds.
incidents.lesson: Revocation must take effect immediately.

incidents.title: Checkout outage: connection pool limit reached again during festive sale
incidents.desc: The same QueuePool overflow error as before: 41% of checkouts failed for 22 minutes after the reconciliation job was scheduled every 15 minutes.
whys: Checkout requests failed with HTTP 500
API workers timed out waiting for a database connection
Reconciliation now runs every 15 minutes and holds connections
Batch jobs and the API share one connection pool with no isolation

incidents.title: Dashboard login rate limit blocks merchants on a shared office IP
incidents.desc: Large merchants with many staff behind one IP address hit the login rate limit at 9 AM every day.
whys: Merchant staff were locked out at login
The rate limit is keyed only on IP address
Rate limiting does not consider user identity
incidents.fix: Keyed the limit on IP plus account.
incidents.lesson: Rate limits need the right key.

incidents.title: Callback storm hit one merchant after a network blip
incidents.desc: After a two-minute network partition the notifier replayed its entire backlog and sent 14,000 events to one merchant within a minute, tripping their firewall.
whys: One merchant was flooded with callbacks
The notifier replayed its whole backlog at once
Webhook retries have no backoff or per-merchant rate limit
incidents.fix: Paused the notifier and drained the backlog slowly by hand.
incidents.lesson: Retries need backoff and limits.

incidents.title: False declines tripled for electronics sellers during sale
incidents.desc: Electronics merchants saw decline rates triple during the Diwali sale; the risk cut-off ignores the merchant's category and typical ticket size.
whys: Legitimate electronics orders were declined
The risk cut-off ignores merchant category
Risk thresholds are hard-coded instead of configured per merchant category

incidents.title: Ledger imbalance alert after currency rounding
incidents.desc: A USD settlement converted at four decimal places produced a one-paisa imbalance that tripped the double-entry check.
whys: Double-entry check raised an imbalance
Amounts were rounded at different stages
Currency conversion rounding is not centralised
incidents.fix: Posted a correcting entry.
incidents.lesson: Round once, in one place.

incidents.title: Read replica lag delays payment status by two minutes
incidents.desc: Merchants polling payment status saw 'created' for up to two minutes after capture because reads go to a lagging read replica.
whys: Payment status was stale for merchants
Status reads are served from a read replica
Replica lag is not monitored or bounded

incidents.title: Webhook retries resend events merchants already acknowledged
incidents.desc: Merchants again report duplicate payment.captured callbacks after a deploy; the worker re-sends events whose 200 OK arrived after the timeout.
whys: Merchants processed duplicate payment.captured events
The retry worker re-sent events that were already delivered
No idempotency key or delivery log for outbound webhooks

incidents.title: UPI payments pending for hours after NPCI slowdown
incidents.desc: During an NPCI degradation, UPI collect requests hung without a timeout and over 2,000 payments remained PENDING until the night reconciliation.
whys: UPI payments stayed in PENDING
Gateway threads blocked waiting for NPCI responses
The UPI code path does not apply any timeout
Gateway client has no circuit breaker or fallback acquirer

debts.title: Separate connection pools for API traffic and batch jobs
debts.desc: Give checkout/status APIs a dedicated pool and run settlement and reconciliation on their own pool with statement timeouts.
debts.cause: Batch jobs and the API share one connection pool with no isolation

debts.title: Outbound delivery log with idempotency keys
debts.desc: Persist every webhook attempt before sending, include an idempotency key header, and never re-send an acknowledged event.
debts.cause: No idempotency key or delivery log for outbound webhooks

debts.title: Exponential backoff and per-merchant rate limit for webhook retries
debts.desc: Retry with jittered exponential backoff and cap events per merchant per minute.
debts.cause: Webhook retries have no backoff or per-merchant rate limit

debts.title: Circuit breaker and fallback acquirer in the gateway client
debts.desc: Trip a breaker on acquirer latency or errors and route to the secondary acquirer.
debts.cause: Gateway client has no circuit breaker or fallback acquirer

debts.title: Apply configurable timeouts on the UPI code path
debts.desc: Pass the gateway timeout settings into the NPCI client and mark timed-out collects for async status checks.
debts.cause: The UPI code path does not apply any timeout

debts.title: Reconciliation test suite for cut-off edge cases
debts.desc: Property-based tests for refunds and captures around midnight, month-end and leap days.
debts.cause: Settlement cut-off rules have no automated reconciliation tests

debts.title: Compute the settlement cut-off in Asia/Kolkata time
debts.desc: Use a timezone-aware cut-off instead of the container clock.
debts.cause: The day boundary uses the container's UTC clock

debts.title: Invalidate the API-key cache on rotation and revocation
debts.desc: Publish key-change events and evict cached validations immediately.
debts.cause: The key cache is not invalidated when keys are rotated or revoked

debts.title: Per-category risk thresholds from configuration
debts.desc: Move risk cut-offs into per-category configuration with an audit trail.
debts.cause: Risk thresholds are hard-coded instead of configured per merchant category

debts.title: Composite index on transactions (merchant_id, created_at)
debts.cause: There is no index on transactions (merchant_id, created_at)

debts.title: Specify and document partial-capture ledger postings
debts.desc: Write the accounting rules for partial and multi-captures and link them from the posting code.

debts.title: Alert and fall back to primary when replica lag exceeds 10 seconds
debts.desc: Monitor replication lag and route status reads to the primary when it is too high.
debts.cause: Replica lag is not monitored or bounded

debts.title: Extend the checkout session TTL during the OTP step
debts.desc: Make session lifetime depend on payment state, not a fixed five minutes.
debts.cause: Session TTL is fixed at 5 minutes regardless of payment step

debts.title: Remove the HACK retry loop in the acquirer client
debts.desc: Self-admitted debt found by the scanner: delete the ad-hoc retry loop once the circuit breaker exists.

debts.title: Centralise currency conversion and rounding
debts.desc: One money module that converts and rounds once, used by ledger and settlement.
debts.cause: Currency conversion rounding is not centralised
